_comments: Controls for script memory for server and client script. Core mode values and gametype values (mp only) are supported.
Note: The gametype should be added as a sub object to the core mode; it will override the core mode values.
Note: The minimum is used to define how much memory is needed to load the animations at match start; acts as a clamp.
VARIABLELIST_PARENT_SIZE - number of parent variables - max: 262144, including per-player
VARIABLELIST_CHILD_SIZE - number of child variables - max: 655360, including per-player
VARIABLELIST_PARENT_SIZE_PER_PLAYER - per-player multiplier to add parent variables. Mimimum is an absolute number, not multiplier.
VARIABLELIST_PARENT_SIZE_PER_AGENT - per-agent multiplier to add parent variables. Mimimum is an absolute number, not multiplier.
VARIABLELIST_CHILD_SIZE_PER_PLAYER - per-player multiplier to add child variables. Mimimum is an absolute number, not multiplier.
VARIABLELIST_CHILD_SIZE_PER_AGENT - per-agent multiplier to add child variables. Mimimum is an absolute number, not multiplier.
SCR_DEBUG_FUNCTION_COUNT - [DEVELOPMENT ONLY] number of functions tracked for the debugger/disassembler. Can be safely increased by design as needed without ship impact.
SCR_DEBUG_FUNCTION_BUFFER_SIZE - [DEVELOPMENT ONLY] size of function buffer used by debugger/disassembler. Can be safely increased by design as needed without ship impact.
